description: Added eleven and thirteen into twenty-four, and brought word of ten of the clock at the Theatre.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Gave the house as two-thirds of Thursday's, and louder, and would not name a sum.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Called the hush no accident, asked about the ending, and pointed with his thumb.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Counted thirteen lines, said the yard had laughed at his, and refused the compliment of a song.
name: Will Kemp

description: Owned Kemp's thirteen, reported the yard rather than his intention, and accepted the morning at the Theatre.
name: William Shakespeare
